    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    Exercises normal (raw), invalid-parameter (negative), and invalid-state
    (failed) operations, capturing the outcome of each attempt.

    # =========================================================

    # Get pre-configured resources
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # Storage for captured simulation outputs
    captured = {"raw": [], "negative": [], "failed": []}

    # --------------------- RAW OUTPUTS ---------------------
    # Standard, valid operations executed and captured as-is
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
    await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[50])
    await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[50])
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
    captured["raw"].append("OK: raw transfer 50uL source[A1] -> dest[A1] completed")

    # Valid mix operation (captured; tolerated if backend rejects parameters)
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["B1"])
    await lh.aspirate(source["B1"], vols=[30])
    try:
        await lh.mix(dest["B1"], vols=[30], repeats=3)
        captured["raw"].append("OK: mix 30uL x3 in dest[B1] completed")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["raw"].append(f"MIX NOTE: mix in dest[B1] returned: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["B1"])

    # ------------------- NEGATIVE OUTPUTS -------------------
    # Operations with negative volumes - capture how simulation responds
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["C1"])
    try:
        await lh.aspirate(source["C1"], vols=[-25])
        captured["negative"].append("NEG: aspirate vols=[-25] returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["negative"].append(f"NEG: aspirate vols=[-25] FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    try:
        await lh.dispense(dest["C1"], vols=[-25])
        captured["negative"].append("NEG: dispense vols=[-25] returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["negative"].append(f"NEG: dispense vols=[-25] FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["C1"])

    try:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["D1"])
        await lh.aspirate(source["D1"], vols=[-100])
        captured["negative"].append("NEG: aspirate vols=[-100] returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["negative"].append(f"NEG: aspirate vols=[-100] FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    finally:
        # Ensure tips are released regardless of outcome
        try:
            await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["D1"])
        except Exception:
            pass  # tips may not have been picked up

    # -------------------- FAILED OUTPUTS --------------------
    # 1) Aspirating without tips should fail
    try:
        await lh.aspirate(source["E1"], vols=[25])
        captured["failed"].append("FAIL: aspirate without tips returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["failed"].append(f"FAIL: aspirate without tips -> {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    # 2) Picking up an already-used tip position should fail
    try:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])  # A1 was used in the raw section
        captured["failed"].append("FAIL: pick_up_tips on used tip A1 returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
        try:
            await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])  # clean up if backend allowed it
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["failed"].append(f"FAIL: pick_up_tips on used tip A1 -> {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    # 3) Over-capacity aspiration (5000uL requested, 50uL tips) should fail
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["E1"])
    try:
        await lh.aspirate(source["E1"], vols=[5000])
        captured["failed"].append("FAIL: aspirate 5000uL with 50uL tips returned SUCCESS (unexpected)")
    except Exception as exc:
        captured["failed"].append(f"FAIL: over-capacity aspirate 5000uL -> {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["E1"])

    # --------------------- REPORT ---------------------
    print("=== CAPTURED SIMULATION OUTPUTS ===")
    for category in ("raw", "negative", "failed"):
        print(f"--- {category.upper()} ---")
        for entry in captured[category]:
            print(f"  {entry}")

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

async def main():

    Main execution function that sets up the liquid handler and runs the protocol.
    """

    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)
